recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-37980; if SupplyDelivery is maintained in the OO incubator or another successor artifact, preserve this delivery-vs-dispense distinction there together with the later dispatch/reception and Transport refinements.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification OO R5 issue requesting replacement SupplyDelivery Scope and Usage plus Boundaries and Relationships text to distinguish SupplyDelivery movement/delivery context from MedicationDispense and DeviceDispense association of an item with a specific patient for use, while retaining purchase-date guidance.
initial_application: Commit c3e16ec64ef2620d5708d9e53c0859bf58c7f415 explicitly implemented FHIR-37980 on 2022-12-03 by changing source/supplydelivery/supplydelivery-introduction.xml. The patch inserted the requested Scope and Usage text, replaced the boundary paragraph, and retained the purchase-date sentence; the commit is an ancestor of the current worker branch.
additional_context: OO/HCP minutes show iterative discussion of the SupplyDelivery/dispense boundary and the 2022-11-14 10-0-0 motion to accept FHIR-37980 with modification. Later SupplyDelivery issues reworked adjacent text: FHIR-38818 added dispatch/reception staging, FHIR-42947 differentiated SupplyDelivery from Transport, and FHIR-51689 adjusted boundary formatting and links. A later core commit, 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32, removed SupplyDelivery from active source/fhir.ini resource/workgroup/security/FMM/code entries and current core pages now link SupplyDelivery to the OO incubator.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current retained source/supplydelivery narrative says SupplyDelivery documents dispatch/receipt and movement, does not imply the supply has been dispensed to the patient or person, and leaves association-for-use to MedicationDispense and DeviceDispense. Since SupplyDelivery is no longer in active current-core build configuration, editing the retained inactive core source copy would not improve the current specification build.
